title: Omukuumi ku lubalama lw’omugga
intro: Mu nsi ekiragiro ky’omutyobooli mwe kyaleeta ennaku mu maka mangi, emmeeme yafuna obubaka obwali busomooza okutya kwonna. Ng’omutima gujjudde obwesige, baatandika ekikolwa eky’okukkiriza ekyandikyusizza ekkubo ly’eggwanga. Amazzi bwe gaasitula omugugu ogw’omuwendo, essuubi lyatabula n’emigga.
clues: Omwana wange namuteeka mu kifuba ne mmuteeka ku mazzi.
Omwana wange yasangiddwa ab’omu maka g’omufuzi, naye omwana wange omulala n’agoberera.
Naddamu okukwatagana n’omwana wange okumuyonsa, nga Allah bwe yasuubiza.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Okufuna okuluhhamizibwa okusuula omwana mu mugga
trial.answer: Okufuna amagezi okusuula omwana mu mugga

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
